_comment: Release settings for scripts/pack.js and scripts/plist.js. See INSTALL.md.
signingKey fixes the extension id and is gitignored — back it up, never regenerate it.
updateBaseUrl is where the crx and update.xml are served from over https.
publishDir is a directory in the repo that is served at that URL; pack.js copies
both files there together, because a crx published without its update.xml is
an update Chrome will never notice.
